commands.label: B-45a5 standing regression guard (was CHK-001's RED artifact): three clauses, all mandatory. (1) Both REVIEW-path gates must keep EXCLUDING an item-level withdrawal authorized by a confirmed decision. (2) Both must keep biting on everything that is NOT withdrawn, including an item that merely shares an authored verificationIntent id alias with a withdrawn one. (3) Both must keep REFUSING every UNBACKED withdrawal: a status flipped by hand with no decisionRef, a dangling decisionRef, a decisionRef naming a real decision that does not list the item, or a decision overwritten to decision=rejected / userConfirmed=false.
